title: Tucker Carlson, Who Broke With Trump, Plans to ‘Help Build a Third Party’
partialText: The influential conservative commentator’s relationship with the president and the G.O.P. fractured over the war with Iran. Now, he says he is charting a new course.

title: Republicans’ Home-Field Edge for Senate Seems Just Enough for Now

title: Ocasio-Cortez Endorses Abdul El-Sayed in Crucial Michigan Senate Race
partialText: The endorsement is the first in a contested Senate primary by Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez this year, in a state that Democrats believe they must hold this fall to win a Senate majority.

title: Russia Bombards Ukrainian Capital With Deadly Wave of Attacks

partialText: Ukraine is taking the war to Russia, but so far President Vladimir V. Putin’s response has been to keep attacking, including with deadly ballistic missile and drone strikes in Kyiv on Thursday.

partialText: Moscow can still inflict serious damage, but its forces are suffering higher casualties than their Ukrainian counterparts, analysts say.
